# The Hexact GraphQL gateway — recovered schema

**Generated by `tools/schema_map.py`. Do not hand-edit.**

Source: `https://api.hexowatch.com/v2/ql`. The vendor publishes no schema for this endpoint and Apollo introspection is disabled, so every name below was recovered from validator error messages.

- **94 namespaces** (53 query, 41 mutation)
- **359 fields**, **489 arguments**, 359 with a recovered return type
- 42081 requests, **0 resolvers entered** (must be 0)

## How this was recovered, and why it is inert

No credential is ever sent, and **every probe carries a deliberately invalid argument**. That second rule is load-bearing rather than decorative: a mutation field with no *required* arguments otherwise reaches its resolver and runs. Measured — `mutation { WatchOps { exportAll { __typename } } }` returned `ExportAllType`, i.e. the export actually executed, unauthenticated. Adding `(zzzNotAnArg: 1)` makes the document fail validation, so `data` is null and no resolver is entered, while the same error list still names every required argument.

The run self-checks this: any probe whose response carried a non-null `data` is counted in `resolvers_entered`, which is reported above and must be zero.

## One gateway, four hostnames

`api.hexowatch.com`, `api.hexomatic.com`, `api.hexospark.com` and `api.hexometer.com` all serve **the same** `/v2/ql`. Measured by sending four different probes to all four hosts and comparing SHA-256 of the response bodies: byte-identical in every case. So a hostname tells you nothing about which product a route belongs to — identify products by namespace prefix, never by host.

**Consequence:** "Hexospark and Hexofy have no API" is true only of REST. Both have namespaces here.

## Coverage limit — read this before concluding anything is absent

3 namespaces returned **no** field names. That means *not discovered*, *not* empty. The oracle only suggests names lexically close to the probe, so a namespace whose fields share no prefix with any seed stays invisible. Treat these as UNKNOWN:

> `mutation:HexomaticAutomationOps`, `mutation:ShortlinkOps`, `query:Scraper`

## Never call these

The session token this gateway wants reaches the **whole account**, including billing. `hexact/graphql.py` enforces an allowlist checked before the request is built. These namespaces are refused by construction:

- `AdminOps`
- `BillingOps`
- `HexomaticAdminOps`
- `Admin`
- `Billing`
- `HexomaticAdmin`
